metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Hong Kong increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P tropospheric NO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2) - Date ranges: * Period 1: February 10-25, 2020 * Period 2: April 20-May 12, 2020 - Location: Hong Kong (approximately 22.3°N, 114.2°E) - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' 2. Masking strategy: - NO2 data has a quality flag; filter using qa_value >= 0.75 (good quality) - Check for valid pixels after filtering - Calculate mean NO2 for each period 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Error: - Valid result: numeric mean NO2 value in reasonable range (0-2e15 molec/cm2) - Invalid (C3): None/NaN values or out-of-range values - No data (C1): Collection empty for one or both periods - No valid pixels (C2): After filtering, 0 pixels remain - Comparison: If Period2_mean > Period1_mean, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Hong Kong geometry const hongKong = ee.Geometry.Point([114.1694, 22.3193]).buffer(50000); // ~50 km buffer // Define time periods const period1Start = '2020-02-10'; const period1End = '2020-02-25'; const period2Start = '2020-04-20'; const period2End = '2020-05-12'; // Sentinel-5P NO2 collection const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2'); // Period 1: Feb 10-25, 2020 const col1 = collection .filterDate(period1Start, period1End) .filterBounds(hongKong); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb 10-25): ${size1} images`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('No data for Period 1.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Period 2: Apr 20-May 12, 2020 const col2 = collection .filterDate(period2Start, period2End) .filterBounds(hongKong); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12): ${size2} images`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('No data for Period 2.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Function to calculate mean NO2 for a collection function getMeanNO2(imgCol, geom) { // Filter by quality flag and add band const filtered = imgCol.map(function(img) { const qa = img.select('qa_value'); const no2 = img.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); return no2.updateMask(qa.gte(0.75)); // Good quality pixels only }); const meanImg = filtered.mean(); const stats = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); const pixelCount = filtered.map(function(img) { return img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); }).getInfo(); return { stats: stats.getInfo(), pixels: pixelCount }; } // Calculate mean NO2 for both periods const result1 = getMeanNO2(col1, hongKong); const result2 = getMeanNO2(col2, hongKong); const mean1 = result1.stats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density; const mean2 = result2.stats.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density; console.log(`Period 1 mean NO2: ${mean1 !== null ? mean1.toFixed(4) : 'null'} molec/cm2`); console.log(`Period 2 mean NO2: ${mean2 !== null ? mean2.toFixed(4) : 'null'} molec/cm2`); console.log(`Valid pixels P1: ${result1.pixels[0] || 0}, P2: ${result2.pixels[0] || 0}`); // Validation if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2) || mean1 < 0 || mean2 < 0 || mean1 > 1e16 || mean2 > 1e16) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (result1.pixels[0] === 0 || result2.pixels[0] === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Compare means const increase = mean2 > mean1; const change = ((mean2 - mean1) / mean1 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${change}%`); if (increase) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
